ligandsStats.map: function (doc) { if (Array.isArray(doc.formula)) { var n = 0; for (var i = 0; i < doc.formula.length; i++) { if (doc.formula[i] && doc.formula[i].label !== 'HOH') n++; } emit(null, n); } }

yearStats.map: function (doc) { if (typeof doc.year === 'number' && doc.year > 0) emit(null, doc.year); }

aminoAcidFreq.map: function (doc) { var aa = { ALA:1, ARG:1, ASN:1, ASP:1, CYS:1, GLU:1, GLN:1, GLY:1, HIS:1, ILE:1, LEU:1, LYS:1, MET:1, PHE:1, PRO:1, SER:1, THR:1, TRP:1, TYR:1, VAL:1 }; if (doc.residueStats) { for (var key in doc.residueStats) { if (aa[key]) emit(key, doc.residueStats[key]); } } }

nucleicBaseFreq.map: function (doc) { var bases = { DA:1, DC:1, DG:1, DT:1, DU:1, A:1, C:1, G:1, U:1, T:1 }; if (doc.residueStats) { for (var key in doc.residueStats) { if (bases[key]) emit(key, doc.residueStats[key]); } } }

moleculeType.map: function (doc) { var aa = { ALA:1, ARG:1, ASN:1, ASP:1, CYS:1, GLU:1, GLN:1, GLY:1, HIS:1, ILE:1, LEU:1, LYS:1, MET:1, PHE:1, PRO:1, SER:1, THR:1, TRP:1, TYR:1, VAL:1 }; var bases = { DA:1, DC:1, DG:1, DT:1, DU:1, A:1, C:1, G:1, U:1, T:1 }; var hasProtein = false; var hasNucleic = false; if (doc.residueStats) { for (var key in doc.residueStats) { if (aa[key]) hasProtein = true; if (bases[key]) hasNucleic = true; } } var category = 'other'; if (hasProtein && hasNucleic) category = 'hybrid'; else if (hasProtein) category = 'protein'; else if (hasNucleic) category = 'nucleic'; emit(category, 1); }

helixKindHist.map: function (doc) { if (Array.isArray(doc.helices)) { for (var i = 0; i < doc.helices.length; i++) { var k = doc.helices[i].kind; if (typeof k === 'number' && !isNaN(k)) emit(k, 1); } } }

helixLengthHist.map: function (doc) { if (Array.isArray(doc.helices)) { for (var i = 0; i < doc.helices.length; i++) { var h = doc.helices[i]; var len = h.to - h.from + 1; if (typeof len === 'number' && !isNaN(len) && len > 0 && len < 200) emit(len, 1); } } }

sheetLengthHist.map: function (doc) { if (Array.isArray(doc.sheets)) { for (var i = 0; i < doc.sheets.length; i++) { var s = doc.sheets[i]; var len = s.to - s.from + 1; if (typeof len === 'number' && !isNaN(len) && len > 0 && len < 200) emit(len, 1); } } }

helicesVsSheets.map: function (doc) { if (typeof doc.nbHelices === 'number' && typeof doc.nbSheets === 'number') emit([doc.nbHelices, doc.nbSheets], 1); }

secondaryStructurePresence.map: function (doc) { if (typeof doc.nbHelices !== 'number' || typeof doc.nbSheets !== 'number') return; var label; if (doc.nbHelices === 0 && doc.nbSheets === 0) label = 'none'; else if (doc.nbHelices > 0 && doc.nbSheets === 0) label = 'helices-only'; else if (doc.nbHelices === 0 && doc.nbSheets > 0) label = 'sheets-only'; else label = 'mixed'; emit(label, 1); }

residuesHistogram.map: function (doc) { if (typeof doc.nbResidues !== 'number' || doc.nbResidues <= 0) return; var n = doc.nbResidues; var bins = [50, 100, 200, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000]; var lower = 0; for (var i = 0; i < bins.length; i++) { if (n < bins[i]) { emit(lower, 1); return; } lower = bins[i]; } emit(lower, 1); }

residuesPerChainStats.map: function (doc) { if (typeof doc.nbResidues === 'number' && typeof doc.nbChains === 'number' && doc.nbChains > 0) emit(null, doc.nbResidues / doc.nbChains); }

ligandFrequency.map: function (doc) { if (Array.isArray(doc.formula)) { for (var i = 0; i < doc.formula.length; i++) { var f = doc.formula[i]; if (f && f.label && f.label !== 'HOH') emit(f.label, typeof f.number === 'number' ? f.number : 1); } } }

ligandMwHistogram.map: function (doc) { if (Array.isArray(doc.formula)) { for (var i = 0; i < doc.formula.length; i++) { var f = doc.formula[i]; if (!f || f.label === 'HOH') continue; var mw = parseFloat(f.mw); if (isNaN(mw) || mw <= 0) continue; var bins = [100, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000]; var lower = 0; var matched = false; for (var j = 0; j < bins.length; j++) { if (mw < bins[j]) { emit(lower, 1); matched = true; break; } lower = bins[j]; } if (!matched) emit(lower, 1); } } }

ligandsByYear.map: function (doc) { if (typeof doc.year === 'number' && doc.year > 0 && typeof doc.nbLigands === 'number') emit(doc.year, doc.nbLigands); }

iepHistogram.map: function (doc) { if (typeof doc.iep === 'number' && !isNaN(doc.iep)) { var bin = Math.floor(doc.iep * 2) / 2; emit(bin, 1); } }

ecClasses.map: function (doc) { if (!doc.chain) return; var seen = {}; for (var key in doc.chain) { var c = doc.chain[key]; if (c && typeof c.ec === 'string' && c.ec.length > 0) { var head = c.ec.charAt(0); if (head >= '1' && head <= '7' && !seen[head]) { seen[head] = true; emit(head, 1); } } } }

residuesByYear.map: function (doc) { if (typeof doc.year === 'number' && doc.year > 0 && typeof doc.nbResidues === 'number') emit(doc.year, doc.nbResidues); }

methodByYear.map: function (doc) { if (typeof doc.year === 'number' && doc.year > 0 && doc.experiment) emit([doc.year, doc.experiment], 1); }

omegaSummary.map: function (doc) { if (doc.omega && typeof doc.omega.nbPeptideBonds === 'number') emit(null, [doc.omega.nbCis, doc.omega.nbTrans, doc.omega.nbTwisted, doc.omega.nbPeptideBonds]); }

omegaByYear.map: function (doc) { if (doc.omega && typeof doc.year === 'number' && doc.year > 0 && typeof doc.omega.nbPeptideBonds === 'number') emit(doc.year, [doc.omega.nbCis, doc.omega.nbTrans, doc.omega.nbTwisted, doc.omega.nbPeptideBonds]); }

twistedPairFrequency.map: function (doc) { if (doc.omega && Array.isArray(doc.omega.twistedBonds)) { for (var i = 0; i < doc.omega.twistedBonds.length; i++) { var b = doc.omega.twistedBonds[i]; if (b && b.residue1 && b.residue2) emit([b.residue1, b.residue2], 1); } } }

pairFrequency.map: function (doc) { if (!doc.omega || !doc.omega.pairCounts) return; var cisByPair = {}; if (Array.isArray(doc.omega.cisBonds)) { for (var i = 0; i < doc.omega.cisBonds.length; i++) { var b = doc.omega.cisBonds[i]; if (b && b.residue1 && b.residue2) { var ck = b.residue1 + ':' + b.residue2; cisByPair[ck] = (cisByPair[ck] || 0) + 1; } } } for (var key in doc.omega.pairCounts) { var idx = key.indexOf(':'); if (idx > 0) emit([key.slice(0, idx), key.slice(idx + 1)], [cisByPair[key] || 0, doc.omega.pairCounts[key]]); } }

pairFrequencyByYear.map: function (doc) { if (!doc.omega || !doc.omega.pairCounts || typeof doc.year !== 'number' || doc.year <= 0) return; var cisByPair = {}; if (Array.isArray(doc.omega.cisBonds)) { for (var i = 0; i < doc.omega.cisBonds.length; i++) { var b = doc.omega.cisBonds[i]; if (b && b.residue1 && b.residue2) { var ck = b.residue1 + ':' + b.residue2; cisByPair[ck] = (cisByPair[ck] || 0) + 1; } } } for (var key in doc.omega.pairCounts) { var idx = key.indexOf(':'); if (idx > 0) emit([doc.year, key.slice(0, idx), key.slice(idx + 1)], [cisByPair[key] || 0, doc.omega.pairCounts[key]]); } }
